title: 幽明 · At the Edge of Things
about: Image records for the guest room of the living painter Anna Vishenskaya. Her works are © the artist and shown with permission; they are deliberately absent from catalog/*.json, the River and every /api route. The three museum works are public-domain reproductions.

artist_texts.quoted: The room quotes the artist’s statement, two shop descriptions and passages from her ArtConnect portfolio word for word, with links. Her bio and exhibition list are paraphrased from her site. The artist agreed to these quotations on 2026-10-24.

interpretation: Passages marked “A reading” and each painting’s returned question are written for the room by Claude (Artbitrage’s AI collaborator), not by the artist.
